long_biography.plain_text:
Traina Enterprises grew from one Lake Allatoona marina into a vertically integrated boating group with six marinas across Georgia and Indiana. Douglas Traina lived in a small house on the first property and hired one employee. As founder and chief executive, he remained closely involved as the business expanded.

A restaurant originally planned as a marina amenity introduced hospitality to the group. Traina's team sketched the idea for Pelican Pete's on a napkin, and the venue's growth led TEI to establish a dedicated restaurant division. Douglas continues as chief executive of the parent company, while Dan Groom-Traina leads its hospitality team as president.
